question: Visualize the p-value and effect size (log2FC) distributions from the provided MeRIP-seq and proteomic data, and perform a chi-square test to evaluate the association between m6A modification status and differential gene expression using the m6A status and DEG status columns already provided in the MeRIP-seq data.

expected_output.description: single numeric value of chi-square test p-value
log2FC as x-axis, frequency as y-axis, 2x2 panel layout with one panel per dataset (proteomic, m6A methylation, gene expression, combined)
p-value as x-axis, frequency as y-axis, 2x2 panel layout with one panel per dataset (proteomic, m6A methylation, gene expression, combined)
